name: Apache PredictionIO

vendor.company: Apache Software Foundation (originally PredictionIO Inc., acquired by Salesforce Feb 2016, then donated to ASF Incubator)
vendor.hq: Apache Software Foundation, Wakefield, MA, USA (original startup: Palo Alto, CA)
vendor.scale: ~12.5k GitHub stars; was a high-profile open-source ML server 2014-2018; last release 0.14.0 (Mar 2019); ~20 source-built engine-template repos under apache/

ports: 8000/tcp (deployed engine server / POST /queries.json + GET / status page)
dorks: http.html:"Engine Factory Class" http.html:"Event Server Port" port:8000

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://TARGET:8000/  (read the status page only - do NOT POST crafted queries to alter behavior). Parallel: GET http://TARGET:7070/ for the Event Server.
verification_primitive.success_signal: Engine server: HTTP 200 with an HTML page whose <title>/<h1> contains 'PredictionIO Engine Server at <ip>:<port>' and body labels 'Engine Factory Class', 'Event Server IP/Port', 'Average Serving Time'. Event server: HTTP 200 body exactly {"status":"alive"}.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Confirms a LIVE unmaintained (Attic-retired) PredictionIO instance. The :8000 status page leaks the full model/algorithm topology unauthenticated, and POST /queries.json is queryable without any credential - an attacker can run unlimited predictions against the production model (model extraction / inference abuse) and read the engine's wiring (algorithm classes, params, Event Server location) to pivot. Restraint note: liveness + status-page read is sufficient to label exposure; do not exercise the model.

endpoints.returns: HTML status page titled 'PredictionIO Engine Server at <ip>:<port>' leaking engine instance details, algorithm class names + params, model toString, data source/preparator/serving params, server start time, Event Server IP+port, request count, avg/last serving time. UNAUTHENTICATED.
The live prediction. For a Recommendation engine, a JSON body like {"user":"1","num":4} returns recommended itemScores. UNAUTHENTICATED by default - anyone reachable can query the model.
{"status":"alive"} health check. UNAUTHENTICATED - confirms it is a PredictionIO Event Server.
Stored training events (up to 20 by default) for an app - REQUIRES ?accessKey=. Returns 401/Unauthorized without a valid key.
Ingests an event - REQUIRES ?accessKey=. Write path is auth-gated.
